svg.title: The Cube
svg.desc: Win+C or a screen edge toggles the cube session, which captures a picture of every desktop and opens a 3D overlay on each monitor. The overlay hands your clicks, keys and drags to the unit-tested CubeController, which picks a desktop; the session then switches Windows to it through Windows' undocumented virtual desktop interfaces. Ctrl+F1 to F4 and the taskbar pager switch desktops directly, and the pager reads the desktops to draw itself. open the cube: Hotkeys & screen edges → CubeSession → Desktop images, CubeOverlay. pick a face: CubeOverlay → CubeController → CubeSession → Windows virtual desktops. a pager click: Taskbar pager → Windows virtual desktops.
